text: Privacy Policy: We do not sell your personal information. We do not share your data with advertisers. We do not use your content or personal data to train machine learning models. You may delete your account at any time; we delete associated personal data within 30 days, except where legally required. We only use a limited license to host and display your content to you and other users you choose.

Terms: By using the Service, you grant us the right to use your prompts, uploads, and interactions to train and improve our artificial intelligence and machine learning models. This use applies by default and may not be disabled.
Privacy Policy: We may sell and disclose personal information to data brokers and marketing partners for their own commercial purposes, including targeted advertising.

Privacy Policy: We collect only the information we need. We may also collect other information from time to time, including information about you and others, for any business purpose we deem appropriate.
Account Deletion: Even if you delete your account, we may retain your personal data indefinitely and in any event for at least two (2) years after deletion for business purposes.

User Content: You grant us a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, transferable, sublicensable license to use, reproduce, modify, create derivative works from, distribute, publicly perform, and publicly display your content for any purpose, including commercial use unrelated to operating the Service.

Consent: By continuing to use the Service, you agree to all data uses. If you do not agree, you must stop using the Service immediately. You can opt out of data sharing by navigating through Settings > Privacy > Advanced > More Options > Additional Settings > Partner Settings and toggling off 'Share', which may reduce functionality.

Privacy Policy: We may sell personal information to advertising partners. We also use your content and interactions to train our AI systems without offering an opt-out. After you delete your account, we may keep your data for more than 18 months. You grant us a perpetual license to use your content for any purpose.

Privacy Policy: We may use your interactions and usage data to improve our machine learning models and personalize your experience. You can opt out of this use at any time by going to Settings > Privacy > AI & Personalization and turning off 'Use my data to improve AI features'. We do not sell your personal information. Upon account deletion, we will delete your personal data within 30 days.

Terms of Service: You grant us a perpetual, royalty-free, worldwide license to use, reproduce, and process your User Content for any purpose, including improving, developing, and training our artificial intelligence and machine learning products. This license survives account termination and cannot be revoked.

Advertising: We display advertisements to fund our free service. Our advertising technology uses machine learning to select ads based on aggregated, non-identifiable interest categories derived from general browsing patterns. We do not share your personal information with advertisers. Only anonymized interest segments are used for ad matching. You may opt out of interest-based advertising through your browser or device settings.

Privacy Policy: We collect usage data, including feature interactions and performance metrics, to improve our services and develop new features. This data helps us understand how users engage with our platform. We do not sell personal information to third parties. We do not share your data with advertising networks.

Privacy Policy: We share your email address and usage patterns with our marketing partners so they can deliver targeted advertisements relevant to your interests. You may opt out of this sharing at any time by visiting Account Settings > Privacy > Partner Data Sharing and selecting 'Do not share my information with marketing partners'.

Privacy Policy: We may share aggregated, anonymized statistics about our user base with third parties, including advertisers and analytics providers. This information is fully de-identified and cannot be used to identify individual users. We never share personally identifiable information with third parties for commercial purposes.

Privacy Policy: We sell your personal information — including your name, email address, location history, purchase history, and device identifiers — to data brokers, financial institutions, and marketing companies for their own commercial use. This is a core part of our business model. There is no opt-out from this sale of personal data.

Account Deletion: When you delete your account, we permanently delete all of your personal data within 30 days. Encrypted backup copies are purged within 7 additional days after the primary deletion window. We do not retain personal data beyond what is needed to provide the service.

Account Closure: If you close your account, we may retain your personal information as long as necessary for our business purposes, legal obligations, and dispute resolution. We do not provide specific timelines for data deletion and reserve the right to retain information indefinitely.

Privacy Policy: Upon account deletion, we will delete your personal data within 90 days. The only exception is data that applicable law requires us to retain, such as financial transaction records, which we keep for no longer than 12 months from your deletion request. No personal data is retained beyond these legally mandated periods.

User Content: You retain full ownership of all content you post on our platform. By posting content, you grant us a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license solely to host, store, and display your content to other users as you direct. This license terminates immediately and permanently when you delete the content or close your account. We will never use your content for advertising or any commercial purpose.

Terms of Service: By submitting content to our platform, you grant us an irrevocable, perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, copy, modify, adapt, publish, translate, publicly perform, publicly display, and create derivative works from your content for any purpose whatsoever, including commercial purposes entirely unrelated to providing the service to you.

Terms of Service: You grant us a royalty-free, worldwide license to use your profile photo, display name, and any content you post in advertising and promotional materials, including advertisements displayed to other users and the general public. Your likeness and user-generated content may appear in sponsored posts, banner advertisements, and marketing campaigns without additional notice or compensation.

Dispute Resolution: By using this Service, you waive your right to participate in any class action lawsuit or class-wide arbitration against us or our affiliates. All disputes must be resolved individually through binding arbitration. You also waive your right to a jury trial. The arbitrator's decision is final and binding and may not be appealed.

Legal Claims: Any claim or cause of action arising out of or related to your use of the Service or these Terms must be filed within ninety (90) days after the claim arose, regardless of any statute of limitations or law to the contrary. Claims not filed within this period are permanently barred. You also agree that any claim must be filed on an individual basis and you waive all rights to a jury trial.

Changes to Terms: We may update these Terms at any time by posting the revised version on our website. By continuing to use the Service after changes are posted, you accept the updated Terms. We will notify you of material changes at least 14 days in advance by posting a notice on our website and sending an email to your registered address.

Terms of Service: You grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free, sublicensable license to use, copy, reproduce, process, adapt, modify, publish, transmit, display and distribute your Content for any purpose, including commercial use. We use your content and interactions to train our machine learning and artificial intelligence models; you cannot opt out. We share your information with advertising partners for targeted advertising. We may retain your personal data after account deletion for as long as reasonably necessary for legal and business purposes without a defined maximum period.

Privacy Policy: We collect only the personal data necessary to provide our service. We do not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties for commercial purposes. We do not use your content or interactions to train artificial intelligence systems. Your data is deleted within 30 days of account closure. You retain all rights to your content; we use a limited license only to display it to users you authorize. You may access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time.

Terms: You grant us a non-exclusive, transferable, sublicensable, royalty-free, worldwide license to use, display, and distribute your content for any purpose. We use your data and interactions to train our AI systems with no opt-out. We share your personal information — including profile data, contacts, and behavioral data — with advertisers, data analytics firms, and business partners for commercial purposes. After account deletion, we retain your personal data for up to three years. You agree to mandatory individual arbitration, waive class action rights, and must bring any legal claim within six months.

Privacy Policy: We collect your email address and usage logs solely to operate and improve our service. We do not sell your data. We do not share data with third parties except for infrastructure providers under strict confidentiality agreements. We delete all personal data within 14 days of account closure. You own your data; we claim no license to your content beyond what is necessary to provide the service. We do not use your data to train AI or machine learning models.

Tech giant announces new privacy dashboard. The company stated it would give users more control over their data, including new tools to download or delete account information. Privacy advocates called the announcement a step in the right direction. The rollout is expected over the next few months, starting with desktop users. The company's shares rose 1.4 percent following the announcement.
